x: It was an added pleasure to note the good walking of our younger men, particularly that of Brian Cornick and Robert Barns. 1st Belgrave H. 45 pts. 2nd Highgate H. 57 pts. 3rd Woodford 62 pts.

…nary resoluteness, the strength of Ray Middleton who must be a future champion, the potential powers of Terry Clark and Brian Cornick, and so through the team to our last man, Percy Wilson, who so typifies the fun and enjoyment obtained from the sport.…

We were without the assistance of both Brian Cornick and Brian Gibbs, and so went to the start with a weakened team. John Knifton was our first man home, although nearly caught by improving Bob Barnes.
Instead of the country team benefitting from this period, John again persuaded him to walk; this time in the Middlesex Junior Mile, where he finished second to Brian Cornick.
